description: This Java class 'EarlyPaymentLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor' extends an abstract class and implements logic for processing early loan repayments in a loan management system. It handles different transaction scenarios such as on-time, late, advance payments, and refunds, applying appropriate allocation rules for interest, principal, fees, and penalties.

classes.name: EarlyPaymentLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A subclass implementing specific logic for handling early loan repayment transactions, including allocation of payments to interest, principal, fees, and penalties according to the early repayment strategy.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code identifier for this repayment strategy, 'early-repayment-strategy'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name for this repayment strategy, 'Early Repayment Strategy'.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Allocates an early payment made in advance to interest, fees, penalties, and principal in that priority, updating the transaction components and mapping.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayments, processing them similarly to on-time payments in this implementation.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Allocates on-time repayment funds, prioritizing interest then principal, and updating the respective components and mappings.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes refund transactions, unpaying fees, penalties, principal, and interest in sequence, updating the installment components and transaction mappings.
